scientific_integrity: The infinite family theorem is proved by direct double-ideal-quotient algebra and singularity analysis, with independent finite exhaustive checks. Computations are corroborative and not substituted for proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only \(S_{m,r}\) with \(r\ge3\) and \(m\ge r+1\), one consecutive terminal gap interval, normalized ideal translation classes. Fixed-r asymptotics are not uniform in r; no general claim for arbitrary numerical semigroups.
title: Sliding-window classification and growth of reflexive ideals in terminal-gap numerical semigroups
